imark.description: Typora / Obsidian style live-preview Markdown editor for VS Code, with Obsidian theme support and Mermaid diagrams.
imark.command.openInIMark.title: Open with iMark
imark.command.openSource.title: Open in Text Editor
imark.command.toggleReadingView.title: Toggle Reading View
imark.command.toggleSourceMode.title: Toggle Live Preview / Source Mode
imark.command.selectTheme.title: Select Theme…
imark.command.reloadTheme.title: Reload Theme
imark.command.importTheme.title: Import Obsidian Theme…
imark.command.removeTheme.title: Remove Imported Theme…
imark.command.openThemesFolder.title: Open Themes Folder
imark.config.title: iMark
imark.config.theme.name.description: Theme to use: `Monokai Syntax` (built-in default), `vscode` (adapt Obsidian variables to the VS Code color theme), `obsidian` (Obsidian's default look) or the id of a theme imported into iMark's library. Use **iMark: Select Theme…** to pick, or **iMark: Import Obsidian Theme…** to add themes.
imark.config.theme.path.description: Optional additional folder of Obsidian themes to offer read-only (e.g. a vault's `.obsidian/themes`). Imported themes live in iMark's own storage regardless of this setting.
imark.config.theme.mode.description: Light or dark variant of the Obsidian theme. `auto` follows the VS Code color theme.
imark.config.theme.snippets.description: CSS snippets to load after the theme: file names imported into iMark's snippet library (see **Import Obsidian Theme…**) or absolute paths.
imark.config.theme.accentColor.descripti: Accent color override as a hex color (e.g. `#7c3aed`). Sets Obsidian's `--accent-h/s/l` variables. Empty keeps the theme's accent.
imark.config.editor.defaultMode.descript: Mode used when a Markdown file is opened.
imark.config.editor.readableLineWidth.de: Limit the maximum line width for comfortable reading, like Obsidian's Readable line length.
imark.config.editor.showInlineTitle.desc: Show the file name as an inline title above the note.
imark.config.editor.showHeader.descripti: Show the Obsidian-style view header with the mode toggle.
imark.config.editor.fontSize.description: Editor font size in pixels. 0 uses the theme's default (`--font-text-size`).
imark.config.editor.lineNumbers.descript: Show line numbers in source mode.
imark.config.editor.spellcheck.descripti: Enable the browser spellchecker inside the editor.
imark.config.editor.autoPairMarkdown.des: Auto-pair Markdown syntax (`*`, `_`, `` ` ``, `~`, `=`, `$`) in addition to brackets and quotes.
imark.config.editor.smartClickLinks.desc: Open links with a plain click when their markup is hidden (live preview). Ctrl/Cmd+click always opens links.
imark.config.attachments.folder.descript: Folder (relative to the note) where pasted or dropped images are stored.
imark.config.attachments.linkStyle.descr: Link syntax used when inserting pasted images: `![](path)` or Obsidian `![[file]]`.
imark.config.editor.wideTables.descripti: Let tables that are wider than the readable line width grow towards the editor width (centred) before scrolling horizontally.
